name: Kil'hala
summary: At the Crossroads in the Barrens, Kil'hala teaches Horde tailors to work cloth. He also weaves nether-lace robes for young Horde mages who bring him locks of hair from Ashenvale's laughing sisters.

sections.title: Tailor of the Barrens
sections.body: Kil'hala trains tailors at the Crossroads, where Horde recruits and travelers can learn his craft. He teaches work with common spun bolts and garments suited to life on the dry plains. At Deino's request, he also makes nether-lace robes for young mages who bring him hair from the laughing sisters, the dryads of Ashenvale's forests.

faq.answer: Kil'hala is a Darkspear troll who trains tailors at the Crossroads in the Barrens. He teaches Horde tradesfolk the basics of weaving cloth and making garments.
Find Kil'hala at the Crossroads, the central Horde settlement in the Barrens. He is alongside the other Horde trade trainers.

faq.q: What tasks does Kil'hala give to tailors?
faq.answer: Kil'hala does not send tailors out himself. Young Horde mages sent by Deino bring him locks of hair from the Laughing Sisters, dryads near Ashenvale's Raynewood Retreat, and he weaves the hair into a nether-lace garment for them.

angles.text: As a Horde tailor, you can learn the craft from Kil'hala at the Crossroads. He also offers a way to weave exotic magical robes.
At the Crossroads, Kil'hala teaches textile crafts and provides goods for Horde warbands and travelers making a foothold in the Barrens.
